featured.title: Anthropic ships Claude Fable 5 — early benchmarks and what changes for builders
featured.excerpt: Claude Fable 5 launched June 11, 2026 with a 30-page system card. Benchmarks, pricing, agentic improvements, and what to test before swapping your default LLM.
featured.tldr: Anthropic released Claude Fable 5 today. It leads Opus 4.6 on agentic SWE-Bench by 7 points and ships a new Mythos sub-variant optimized for narrative tasks. Pricing matches the Sonnet tier, with no API contract changes required.
